claims.sourceText: Deputy Secretary of Defense, SAPOC Information Bulletin, November 1994, https://sgp.fas.org/othergov/sapoc.html
claims.text: The committee's membership in November 1994: 'The SAPOC is chaired by the Honorable John Deutch, DEPSECDEF, with permanent members the Honorable Paul Kaminski USD(A&T), the Honorable Walter Slocombe USD(P), ADM William A. Owens, VCJCS, and the Honorable Emmett Paige Jr., ASD(C3I). BGEN Mike Kostelnik, OUSD(A&T), serves as both member and executive secretary to the SAPOC in his capacity as director of the SAPCO (SAP Coordinating Office). SAPOC membership is not further delegable.'

claims.nodeLabel: DoD special access programme governance change, 5 January 1994
claims.sourceText: Deputy Secretary of Defense, Special Access Program Oversight Committee, Information Bulletin, November 1994, as transcribed at https://sgp.fas.org/othergov/sapoc.html
claims.text: The change and its date: 'On January 5th, 1994, the Deputy Secretary of Defense (DEPSECDEF) significantly enhanced changes in the DoD Special Access Program (SAP) management and control structures. ... The plan standardized and formalized the SAP approval, termination, revalidation and restructuring process through the Special Access Program Oversight Committee (SAPOC). A Senior Review Group (SRG) was established to support the SAPOC principals.' Tier 2 because the text opened is a transcription published by the Federation of American Scientists and no scan of the original bulletin was found from this environment.

claims.sourceText: Deputy Secretary of Defense, Special Access Program Oversight Committee, Information Bulletin, November 1994, as transcribed at https://sgp.fas.org/othergov/sapoc.html
claims.text: The committee was established on 5 January 1994, sixteen years before the directive this node cites. A Deputy Secretary of Defense information bulletin of November 1994 states: 'On January 5th, 1994, the Deputy Secretary of Defense (DEPSECDEF) significantly enhanced changes in the DoD Special Access Program (SAP) management and control structures. ... The plan standardized and formalized the SAP approval, termination, revalidation and restructuring process through the Special Access Program Oversight Committee (SAPOC). A Senior Review Group (SRG) was established to support the SAPOC principals.' Tier 2 because the text opened is a transcription published by the Federation of American Scientists and no scan of the original bulletin was found from this environment.

claims.sourceText: Deputy Secretary of Defense, SAPOC Information Bulletin, November 1994, https://sgp.fas.org/othergov/sapoc.html
claims.text: The 1994 membership was five principals and an executive secretary, not the roughly eighteen of the later instruction: 'The SAPOC is chaired by the Honorable John Deutch, DEPSECDEF, with permanent members the Honorable Paul Kaminski USD(A&T), the Honorable Walter Slocombe USD(P), ADM William A. Owens, VCJCS, and the Honorable Emmett Paige Jr., ASD(C3I). BGEN Mike Kostelnik, OUSD(A&T), serves as both member and executive secretary to the SAPOC in his capacity as director of the SAPCO (SAP Coordinating Office). SAPOC membership is not further delegable.' The node's argument about a large in-house validating body describes the later era, not this one.
